main_text.l: sis, infimæ puerorum Scholæ, in discen-

l.i: Aptet auarus opes, petat ambitiosus honores.
Huius quos Vitæ simulachrũ fallit inane:
Rectius ô quanto Vixit Fabricius ille,
Quæ pueros inter medium, tenerámque iuuentam,
Et numerorum arte mira simul arte docentem,
Coniuge post decadas septé, & tres insuper annos
Elata, nonam decada, anno Vix minus Sno,

page.notes: Upper verse is a partly damaged italic passage; readings such as "Cantilla", "Setrum", "Vres", "Sonisque", "Sandoremque", "Nulla" are doubtful. Numerals "Vix", "Sno", "Siuum" and similar are uncertain. Bottom-left and right of the page show only faint marks, not transcribed.
